snippet.title: Rampancy 1.7 Trailer
snippet.description:
Rampancy 1.7 Update

Version 1.7 brings a major expansion and a full pass of improvements across the entire game.

A brand new map has been added, bringing the total to **10+ maps**. This new area also introduces additional lore and new terminal entries that expand the story and world building.

Player movement has been reworked. The base run speed has been slightly reduced, but a new **sprint mechanic** has been added—holding **Spacebar** now allows the player to move significantly faster during combat and traversal.

Several systems and environments have also been improved:

* Added more destructible environmental elements
* Improved enemy AI behavior and responsiveness
* Full pass of polishing across every map for better flow and consistency
* Added a secret hidden in the starting area
* Reworked health indicator system

  * Removed numeric 1–100 display
  * Replaced with animated health bar
  * Green = high health
  * Yellow = medium health
  * Red = critical health
* Heavily revised and improved the ending for a more polished conclusion

This update focuses on tightening gameplay, improving readability, and expanding both narrative and exploration.
https://lazyspar7an.itch.io/rampancy
